settings.note: Binary model with drop-groups first, direct feature correction for W2 health, then split specified W2/W3 groups into configured subscales.

subscale_config.purpose: Subscale definitions for Feature_Decomposition after correcting W2 self-rated health and revising SEL subscales.
subscale_config.scoring_note: Each subscale is scored as the row-wise mean of its included items in the current Feature_Decomposition script.

v52_health.note: W2 self-rated health is stored as the scalar column v52. v521 was an obsolete mapping label and is not a dataset column. W2 self-worth is a separate item set v52_1 to v52_3 and is retained as its own feature group.
